group: # Built-in voicelines for action groups. The player picks and changes them in the VAB and SPH (Action Group Voicelines).
# group: abort gear lights brakes rcs sas, or custom (a preset for Custom 1 to 10, never assigned by itself), or reply (a standard answer of Mission Control).
# state: on, off or any. Only gear, lights, brakes, rcs and sas have on and off. speaker: auto (a kerbal) or mc. mode: radio or intercom.
# default on: switched on for a craft without voicelines of its own. Brakes, RCS and SAS are off: they change too often in a flight.
# spanish is what the voice says (it becomes loñapsE), english is the subtitle.
# reply_spanish and reply_english: what Mission Control answers to that row. Empty: one of the reply rows. A line the player wrote gets a reply row too, unless the player typed an answer.

speaker: auto
reply_english: Abort confirmed! Recovery teams are on their way!

speaker: auto
reply_english: Copy, emergency separation! We are tracking you!

speaker: auto
english: We need to get out of here!
reply_english: Copy! Get clear of the rocket!

speaker: auto
spanish: ¡Control de Misión, iniciamos el aborto de emergencia!

speaker: mc
english: Abort confirmed! Get out of there!

speaker: auto
reply_english: Copy. You are cleared to land.

speaker: auto
reply_english: Copy, we see the speed coming down.

speaker: auto
reply_english: Copy, you are free to roll.

speaker: auto
spanish: Sistema de control de reacción activado.

speaker: auto
spanish: Propulsores de maniobra fuera de línea.
reply_spanish: Confirmamos los propulsores fuera de línea.

group: # speaker probe: a beep of a probe core, which has no kerbal to speak. beep is the mood, english the subtitle [beeps ...] with 1 to 3 lowercase words.
# A group can have more than one beep, one is picked at random. default works like for a voiceline, and a custom row is a preset.
# reply_spanish and reply_english: what Mission Control answers to the beep. Empty: one of the reply rows.

speaker: probe
reply_english: Abort confirmed! Recovery teams are on their way!
